description: Quantization parameters. UInt8 bounds should be set from streaming global min/max or conservative documented bounds with saturation analysis.

uint16.note: Preserves approximately hundredths of a magnitude over a wide range.

uint8.note: Codes 0..254 map linearly from m_min to m_max; 255 = NoData. Bounds refined after streaming scan.

pristine_default_note: Valid-cell default for omitted pristine tiles; all-NoData tiles use NoData, not this value. Measure error vs true values.
